name: WarGrowlmon
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the top 2 cards of your deck. Then, this Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.) until your opponent's turn ends.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Megidramon] or [ChaosGallantmon] in its name in the hand. For every 10 total cards in both players' trashes, reduce this effect's digivolution cost by 1.
source_effect: [On Deletion] Trash your opponent's top security card.
